calibration.batch_selection: first size-32 batch in each epoch-0 window starting 0,128,256,384

data_access: training payloads only; split metadata for isolation
failure_policy: preserve failed evidence; correct implementation defects with source revision record; scientific recipe changes require a new prospective rule before rerun; no outcome-based retuning

optimizer.scheduler: all three groups use inherited 117132-update warmup/cosine

overfit.anchors: first four action anchors of first full calibration batch, same both arms
overfit.schedule: same Adam groups at constant 0.0001; no warmup; joint clipping 1

recovery.compare: bitwise digest of all saved model, Adam, scheduler, RNG, cursor and exposure-chain state against uninterrupted four updates
recovery.kill_location: after first predictor backward microbatch, before shared backward and optimizer step

resource.extra_probes: shortest batch; batch containing longest training episode; batch containing longest instruction (character count; first tie)
resource.projection: 1.2*max(mean of first 128 end-to-end steps, p95 of those steps)*117132/3600, plus measured checkpoint overhead every 2000 updates
resource.selection: first 128 exact epoch-0 mixed logical batches; cold caches
